## European Chemical Distribution, Done Reliably Since 1999

Arpadis supplies acrylates, monomers, polyurethanes, glycols, solvents, and alternative feedstocks
to manufacturers across Europe. With operations in Belgium, Italy, France, the UK, and Portugal, we
combine local market knowledge with strong global sourcing to ensure consistent, compliant supply.

We partner with leading international producers and third-party service providers to offer
value-added services including repacking, dilution, custom blending, and multiple packaging options.
Our logistics network and SAP-integrated operations enable fast delivery, accurate documentation,
and full traceability.

Backed by ISO 9001:2015 certification, Responsible Care membership, an EcoVadis rating, and more
than two decades of experience, Arpadis provides dependable distribution for coatings, inks,
adhesives, plastics, foams, and specialty applications.

_crawl.linkedin_about: The Behn Meyer Group of Companies dates back to 1840 when two young men from Hamburg, Theodor August Behn and Valentin Lorenz Meyer, established Behn, Meyer & Co. in Singapore. Since its early beginnings in trading and shipping, Behn Meyer has evolved into a specialty supplier for a wide variety of industries across the globe. Today, the Behn Meyer Group combines the distribution of renowned brands with the development of its own products. Behn Meyer’s core business units service a variety of industries: AgriCare Fertilizers, Crop Protection, Additives & Specialities and Agri Analytics & Services Ingredients Food Ingredients, Animal Nutrition & Health, Aquaculture and Personal Care, Home Care & Pharma Performance Chemicals Coatings & Construction, Leather & Textile, Oil & Gas, Process Industries and Water Treatment Polymers Plastics, Rubber and Tyres & Friction Behn Meyer’s global team of over 1,300 employees aims for the highest level of support for all our customers and suppliers. Our network covers more than 16 countries in Asia, Europe and the USA. Driven to find solutions, our R&D facilities guarantee product quality and innovative capability. Our exciting history is one of persistence, partnership and innovation. We continue to shape solutions for the future and focus on building lasting relationships with our customers and suppliers. You can view Behn Meyer's EcoVadis Recognition Page here: https://recognition.ecovadis.com/pKB6zEEtJUWdBnWLnNCfQA

adhesive solutions for many industries. Whether automotive, rail and aviation industry, electrical

_crawl.linkedin_about: Brenntag is the global market leader in chemicals and ingredients distribution and holds a central role in connecting customers and suppliers of the chemical industry. Headquartered in Essen, Germany, we have more than 18,100 employees worldwide and operate a network of around 600 sites in more than 70 countries. In 2024, the company generated sales of €16.2 billion. The two global divisions, Brenntag Essentials and Brenntag Specialties, provide a diversified and broad portfolio of industrial and specialty chemicals and ingredients as well as tailor-made application, marketing and supply chain solutions, technical and formulation support, comprehensive regulatory know-how and digital solutions for a wide range of industries. Brenntag pursues an ambitious sustainability agenda and is committed to sustainable solutions in its own sector and the industries served. Brenntag SE shares have been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2010 and have been part of the DAX since September 2021. In addition, the Brenntag SE shares are listed in the DAX 30 ESG and DAX ESG Target.

# CG 1962 | Chemikalien

Chemie die verbindet.

**Wir verbinden Erfahrung und Innovation**
Gestartet 1962 als regionaler Chemikalienhändler, sind wir heute ein international vernetzter
Distributor, Dienstleister und Produzent von Grund- und Spezialchemikalien für die Industrie.

## CG Pharma & Biotech

Von Reinraum bis Speziallogistik.

Zuverlässige Quellen und Ketten der Lieferung, eigene Analytik und Produktionskapazitäten unter
Reinraumbedingungen der Klassen C und D, branchenspezifische Logistikkonzepte – CG 1962 kennt die
Anforderungen der Pharmaindustrie genau und steht bereit, als kompetenter Partner gemeinsame
Lösungen zu erzielen.

 

[CG Pharma & Biotech][28]   

## Health & Nutrition

Sicherheit für die Lebensmittel­produktion.

Bei der Herstellung von Lebensmitteln ist – nicht zuletzt aufgrund strenger gesetzlicher Vorgaben –
die strikte Einhaltung von Grenzwerten in Zusatzstoffen Pflicht. Wir können diese Pflicht erfüllen
und Produkte beisteuern, die so arm an Fremdstoffen sind, dass sie auch die strengen Anforderungen
der Herstellung von Säuglingsnahrung leicht erfüllen.

 

[Health & Nutrition][29]     [Health & Nutrition Produkt Portfolio][30]

 

[Health & Nutrition]

## Industrie- & Spezial­chemikalien

Großes Portfolio,
persönliche Beratung.

Mit unseren umfassend sortierten Produktportfolios an Industrie- und Spezialchemikalien, Services
und spezialisierten Teams unterstützen wir in langjährigen Partnerschaften Unternehmen aus
verschiedenen industriellen Zweigen – auch mit individueller Beratung, maßgeschneiderter Beschaffung
und eigener Logistik.

 

[Industrie- & Spezialchemikalien][31]     [Produkt Portfolio][32]

## Wasser­chemie

Wasser in Perfektion.

Wir sind ein erfahrener Partner auf dem Gebiet der industriellen Wasserbehandlung. Mit unserem
Sortiment aus rund 3.000 Industrie- und Spezialchemikalien und einer hauseigenen Reihe von
Wasserbehandlungs­produkten haben wir alles parat, was für die Wasserchemie benötigt wird. Unser
erfahrenes Experten Team berät Sie persönlich vor Ort.

Willkommen im Zentrum der Chemie!

ausgerichtet. Von verschiedenen Standorten in Deutschland, Österreich und der Schweiz aus beliefern

# The trusted global distributor and development partner for ingredients and specialty chemical
# solutions

At Caldic, partnerships come first. We collaborate closely with customers and suppliers to enable
them to bring breakthrough innovations to market across the life science and material science
sectors. By combining technical expertise, local presence and a people-driven mindset, we go beyond
supply chain excellence to spark what’s next in healthier living and sustainable materials. 

[Explore our solutions][37]

## We go beyond distribution to co-create solutions that enable our customers to create entirely new
## product categories.
* ### Co-create tailored solutions
  
  We collaborate closely with customers and suppliers to develop tailored solutions grounded in deep
  technical, market, and local expertise.
* ### Breakthrough innovations
  
  With over 70 application laboratories worldwide, our R&D teams co-create formulations that deliver
  superior quality and greater market value.
* ### Beyond supply chain excellence
  
  Our advanced supply chain facilities deliver custom-blended and packed solutions that reduce
  complexity, accelerate speed-to-market and get high-quality products production-ready.
* ### Global reach, local precision
  
  With teams in 44 countries, we combine global sourcing with local delivery to scale fast and meet
  market demands with deep insight and technical agility.

## Our Sustainability Report 2025 is here

Discover how we're turning our purpose, 'Because we care', into measurable progress across our
business. Explore our latest sustainability achievements, ESG initiatives, and the actions we're
taking to create long-term value for our people, customers, partners, and communities.

[**Read the report**][38]

[Cover page of the Caldic Sustainability Report 2025 showcasing the company’s sustainability
performance, ESG priorities, and commitment to responsible growth across its global operations]

## Solutions that go beyond distribution 

By connecting our market insight and entrepreneurial mindset with our deep customer understanding,
we develop tailored solutions across food, (bio)pharma, personal care and industrial applications.
From formulation to delivery, every detail reflects our care. With insight and agility, we help
simplify supply chains and unlock value at every step. 

[Discover our market solutions][39]

## Rooted in local teams, connected across the globe 

With teams in 44 countries and facilities across the Americas, Europe and Asia-Pacific, we combine
global sourcing with local last-mile delivery. Our on-the-ground experts build strong customer
relationships and respond with speed, insight and precision. From sourcing and reformulating to
blending, labeling and resizing, our regional agility drives growth in dynamic, fast-moving markets.
We deliver fast, custom solutions - from bakery mixes to specialty pharma-grade solvents for nearby
hospital hubs. 

[Discover our global reach][40]

# The trusted global distributor and development partner for ingredients and specialty chemical
# solutions

At Caldic, partnerships come first. We collaborate closely with customers and suppliers to enable
them to bring breakthrough innovations to market across the life science and material science
sectors. By combining technical expertise, local presence and a people-driven mindset, we go beyond
supply chain excellence to spark what’s next in healthier living and sustainable materials. 

[Explore our solutions][37]

## We go beyond distribution to co-create solutions that enable our customers to create entirely new
## product categories.
* ### Co-create tailored solutions
  
  We collaborate closely with customers and suppliers to develop tailored solutions grounded in deep
  technical, market, and local expertise.
* ### Breakthrough innovations
  
  With over 70 application laboratories worldwide, our R&D teams co-create formulations that deliver
  superior quality and greater market value.
* ### Beyond supply chain excellence
  
  Our advanced supply chain facilities deliver custom-blended and packed solutions that reduce
  complexity, accelerate speed-to-market and get high-quality products production-ready.
* ### Global reach, local precision
  
  With teams in 44 countries, we combine global sourcing with local delivery to scale fast and meet
  market demands with deep insight and technical agility.

## Our Sustainability Report 2025 is here

Discover how we're turning our purpose, 'Because we care', into measurable progress across our
business. Explore our latest sustainability achievements, ESG initiatives, and the actions we're
taking to create long-term value for our people, customers, partners, and communities.

[**Read the report**][38]

[Cover page of the Caldic Sustainability Report 2025 showcasing the company’s sustainability
performance, ESG priorities, and commitment to responsible growth across its global operations]

## Solutions that go beyond distribution 

By connecting our market insight and entrepreneurial mindset with our deep customer understanding,
we develop tailored solutions across food, (bio)pharma, personal care and industrial applications.
From formulation to delivery, every detail reflects our care. With insight and agility, we help
simplify supply chains and unlock value at every step. 

[Discover our market solutions][39]

## Rooted in local teams, connected across the globe 

With teams in 44 countries and facilities across the Americas, Europe and Asia-Pacific, we combine
global sourcing with local last-mile delivery. Our on-the-ground experts build strong customer
relationships and respond with speed, insight and precision. From sourcing and reformulating to
blending, labeling and resizing, our regional agility drives growth in dynamic, fast-moving markets.
We deliver fast, custom solutions - from bakery mixes to specialty pharma-grade solvents for nearby
hospital hubs. 

[Discover our global reach][40]

## Sustainability anchored in action 

Sustainability is built into how we care, innovate and grow. We help reduce environmental impact by
sourcing renewable energy, designing recyclable packaging and prioritizing safe, ethical workplaces.
We help customers reach their decarbonization goals by formulating products with responsibly sourced
materials, including bio-based options that support circularity. Smarter logistics and sustainable
design help reduce waste across the value chain. With a global EcoVadis Platinum rating at Group
level and 20 Platinum-rated entities, placing us in the top one percent globally, we are committed
to continuous improvement and long-term value creation. 

[Read about our impact][41]

## A place where you’re empowered to thrive

At Caldic, we empower people to shape their future. Whether you’re formulating new products, leading
supply chains, or scaling operations globally, you’ll thrive in our entrepreneurial environment. We
champion inclusivity, encourage innovation, and offer structured professional growth opportunities
like our Caldic Academy. With global mobility opportunities and a trusted Speak Up culture, we’re
building careers that reflect personal goals and global ambition. 

[Find your role][42]

## Want to partner with us?

By combining technical expertise, agile operations, and hands-on local support, we help our
customers unlock new opportunities and deliver meaningful impact. Discover how our solutions can
elevate your business. Let’s collaborate to achieve excellence together. 

[Start a conversation][43]

_crawl.linkedin_about: ChemStationAsia (CSA) has progressed into a leading chemical solvents distributor in the ASEAN Region, offering a complete range of related services such as chemical manufacturing, storage terminals and logistics. We have significant presence in 19 major cities across the ASEAN Region and an Export Department in Singapore to easily reach anyone in any part of the world. CSA is also one of the largest privately held chemical products suppliers in the region and a major formaldehyde resins producer in Malaysia and Vietnam. Our upstream business gains advantages from the direct purchase of raw materials through our distribution arm while our distribution network is strongly supported by our managed fleet of vehicles and owned storage tanks. With the core businesses complementing one another, CSA is poised to be "the Most Valuable Chemical Company"​ in South East Asia.

We have a wide commercial network with presence in 15 countries in the form of branches and subsidiaries. Our company is made up of more than 420 people who offer solutions to customers all over the world. Actually we are working in different business areas such as : Plant protection, Household, public health, gardening, cosmetics, pharmacy, food, rubber, adhesives, polyurethane, coatings, construction, industrial colour (pigments, paint & coatings), plastics, ceramics, foundries, paper, textile, fibres, refineries and electronics.

With a second office in New York and sales offices in Manchester, Barcelona, Tokyo, Shanghai, Hong Kong and Sao Paolo, we have the ability to deliver our products worldwide. ECEM is a privately owned company, financially independent and profitable company since being founded. We’re a transparent, practical yet professional and skilled team with an excellent problem solving track-record. We’ve constructed specialized in-house ERP software to meet our customer demands, including order processing, quality control and stock and supply chain management, which is in the core of our business processing.

As a family-owned company, we’re committed to quality, integrity, and building partnerships that enable innovation. Glue Doctors® Expertise: 200+ Engineering Sales Reps and in-house technical team delivering tailored assembly solutions. One-Stop Global Supply Chain: Local inventory with global logistics for dependable, timely delivery. Value-Added Services: Custom formulation, labeling, low-pressure molding, converting, kit packing, and ePlus inventory solutions. The Ellsworth Advantage: Our experts help customers spec, validate, and implement complete production solutions. Providing Traceability & Accuracy: •Four ISO 9001:2015 & AS9120B Certified locations in North America •DDTC registered with ITAR compliance programs in place •MIL-SPEC, RoHS & REACH options Ellsworth Corporation is an Equal Opportunity Employer. ## Products that drive innovation

Products Industries
Additives Performance Materials & Fillers Personal Care Pigments & Dyes Resins
Additives
[ Learn more ][10]

Additives are the salt in the soup when it comes to coating formulations. Whether you need an
adhesion promoter, accelerator, defoamer or any other additive to enhance the performance of your
formulation – Grolman can offer a wide range of additives that help you solve your formulation
challenges. Contact us and let us know how we can help you.

 

Performance Materials & Fillers
[ Learn more ][11]

High quality products require Performance!

Either you look for
* Mechanical strength
* Barrier properties
* Heat transfer
* Thermal Insulation
* Electrical & thermal conductivity
* Electrical insulation
* Durability
* Resilience
* Ageing stability
* Dimensional stability
* Light reflectance
* Matting effects
* Rheology improvers
* Ease of processing
* Sound deadening
  

and many other features including a synergistic combination of multiple of them.

You’ll find your topmost performing solutions in our portfolio of performance materials and
functional fillers. High quality products also require sustainability! If you are interested in
combining performance with effective circularity and efficient energy use, please reach out to us!

Personal Care
[ Learn more ][12]

Creating cutting-edge personal care products starts with the finest ingredients. Grolman’s extensive
portfolio includes active ingredients, functional ingredients, pigments and additives that enhance
product stability, texture, effectiveness and aesthetics. Whether for skin care, hair care,
toiletries or decorative cosmetics, our ingredients enable manufacturers to develop innovative,
sustainable solutions that stand out in the market.

Get in touch with us to see how our ingredients can help your personal care products succeed.

Pigments & Dyes
[ Learn more ][13]

Imagine a world without colours. From a soft grey to a powerful red, from bright white to intensive
black and every brilliant shade you can think of: Colour is everywhere. Within our Pigments & Dyes
division we offer an extensive portfolio of different colourant groups: Black and white pigments,
organic and inorganic colour pigments and dyes as well as all kinds of effect pigments and dyes.
Find out how we can support your coloration challenges.

Resins
[ Learn more ][14]

Resins and hardeners are an integral part of formulations across various applications. Grolman
offers a portfolio of specialty resins and hardeners that enable our customers to formulate products
for different purposes – like the varnish on your garden fence, the wall paint in your living room,
polymers for the caulk in your bathroom or curing agents for the epoxy adhesive in your brand new
electrical vehicle. Contact us and find out which solutions we can offer you.

[Calf eating feed from a blue trough while a farmer fills it in a modern livestock barn.]
Essential oils are gaining popularity across the feed industry as producers respond to regulatory
changes and sustainability requirements. The shift to essential oils reflects a move towards natural
feed additives that support modern feed strategies, while maintaining compliance with evolving
standards.

### [A Low-CO₂ Revolution in Construction Chemicals][100]

[Worker preparing mortar at a construction site using composite cement and building construction
chemicals.]
This article examines the shift from pure cement (CEM I) to low-CO₂ composite cement (CEM II/III) in
the global construction industry. It looks at the challenges mortar producers face when
reformulating for lower clinker content and shows how building construction chemicals are essential
to maintaining performance.

_crawl.linkedin_about: IMCD is a global leader in the distribution and formulation of speciality chemicals and ingredients, providing solutions to its partners. Across eight Business Groups*, its market specialists collaborate with suppliers and customers to help co-formulate solutions that embrace industry trends. With a global presence across EMEA, Asia-Pacific and the Americas, IMCD offers a range of comprehensive product portfolios. Listed at Euronext, Amsterdam (IMCD), IMCD realised revenues of EUR 4,727 million in 2024 with over 5,126 employees in over 60 countries on six continents. IMCD's dedicated technical and commercial experts work in close partnership to tailor best-in-class solutions for around 60,000 customers and a diverse range of world-class suppliers. For you, and for us, we are creating a world of opportunity. *Our business groups are Home Care and I&I, Beauty & Personal Care, Food & Nutrition, Advanced Materials, Coatings & Construction, Pharmaceuticals, Lubricants & Energy and Industrial Solutions.

# **Welcome to Jebsen & Jessen Ingredients**

****

**Jebsen & Jessen Ingredients** is a leading distributor and solutions provider of specialty
chemicals and life science ingredients in Southeast Asia. We connect global technology leaders with
manufacturers to deliver more than just products — we offer tailored solutions to formulation,
material, and process challenges. With over 60 years of regional experience and teams on the ground
in Indonesia, Malaysia, Myanmar, the Philippines, Singapore, Thailand, and Vietnam, we bring deep
local knowledge and hands-on technical support to every project. Our seven business lines span
Coating & Resins, Plastics & Rubber, Performance Chemicals, Feed, Food, Pharmaceuticals, and
Personal Care. Known for our professionalism, reliability, and long-standing partnerships, we’re
here to help our customers innovate and grow.

[Learn more about us][35]

# **Working With Us**

Apart from world-class product solutions and a strong technical team, our clients can also benefit
from our other services.

[handshake icon]

#### World-class Infrastructure

From state-of-the-art warehousing processes and labs, to modern IT systems, our infrastructure
allows us to serve our clients better.

[database icon]

#### SAP Integrated

All of our offices and infrastructure run on one SAP system. This gives us and our partners full
transparency of our supply chain processes.

[regulatory affairs icon]

#### Regulatory Affairs

Asia’s regulations can be difficult to navigate. Our local experts provide a deep understanding of
local policies to ensure full compliance.

[customer service icon]

#### Customer Service teams

Our local customer service teams in each country make sure customers can rely on us. They are there
for our clients every step of the way.

[certification icon]

#### ISO Certifications

Our entities and infrastructure are certified to the latest ISO standards, allowing us to
continuously improve the quality of our operations.

[compliance icon]

#### Compliance & Anti-Corruption

Strong compliance and anti-corruption practices across all of our departments help us create trust
with our technology partners and customers.

_crawl.linkedin_about: We promote and distribute chemical and life science ingredients for multiple industrial and manufacturing applications. Our local-language technical sales and customer service staff connect technology from more than 105 technology partners to more than 4,000 customers across South East Asia. In business for over 60 years, we operate seven regional business lines: Coating & Resins, Plastics & Rubber, Performance Chemicals, Feed, Food, Pharmaceuticals and Personal Care. Our country and regional industry experts continuously update customers and partners with market intelligence and trends. Company facts - Direct presence in 7 countries, including emerging markets, with local-language technical sales and customer service staff at 12 locations - Locally present and regionally integrated distribution partner, with regional technical sales and distribution network covering all of South East Asia - World-class, certified warehouses in each market - 600m² of regional innovation labs to support product development - Distributing over 100,000 tonnes of specialty chemicals and ingredients annually - More than 105 technology partners, including the world’s leading brands - Serving over 4,000 customers throughout the region Solving problems face-to-face Using our technical expertise and extensive portfolios, we solve our customers’ problems. Building on many years of service, our close relationships with local and multinational customers enable solutions on the ground. Expert teams in Regulatory Affairs, Import-Export, and Supply Chain Management ship, clear, store and deliver products with efficient, compliant and responsive service. A partner for opportunity For our technology partners we offer shorter lead times, a local and regional warehouse network, attractive credit terms and a professional, local-language sales force. We have evolved through our ability to adapt to changing needs and continue to actively develop new solutions for new needs.

# Welcome to K K Chem India Pvt Ltd.

We are among the fastest growing chemical distribution companies in India.

[Our Principals][9]

## About Us

K K Chem India Pvt Ltd. (formerly K. K. Chempro (I) Pvt. Ltd. (ISO 9001 company)) is one of the
fastest growing speciality chemical distribution companies in India and represents the most reputed
global chemical companies for various regions and product lines. The company and its group of
companies and diversification have reached a turnover of nearly 30 million USD.

KKCIPL specialises in distributing Silicone/Acrylic/Silica/Surfactants/Amines/Solvents and many more
chemistries in the diversified market. The major market coverage is with Convertors. The industries
catered to are PAPER/PLASTICS/TEXTILES/AGRO/CONSTRUCTION/CHEMICAL INTERMEDIATES/PETROLEUM and many
more.

KKCIPL has received several accolades from its PRINCIPALS for new product launches, technical
support, development and identifying market gaps.

[Company Information][10]

K K Chem India Pvt Ltd. has successfully completed the assessment conducted by Great Place To Work®,
India, and is certified as a great workplace.

Category: Under 100 Employees

[View Certification][11]

## Our Principals

#### Over the years, we have partnered with a global network of distributors to ensure we can
#### deliver anywhere around the world. Each of our channel partners bestows us with 100% of their
#### trust.

[][12]

#### [Dow Consumer Solutions][13]

Dow Consumer Solutions represents silicone-based product lines under the brand name ‘Dowsil’. Its
top market constitutes mobility, building construction & infrastructure, film tapes & release
liners, beauty & personal care and many more.

[Learn More][14]

[][15]

#### [Dow Industrial Solutions][16]

Dow Industrial Solutions contains product lines based on plastics, industrial intermidiates,
polyurethanes, coatings etc.

[Learn More][17]

[][18]

#### [Dupont Multibase][19]

Product line is related to material reinforcement with Si Additives. Various silicone masterbatches
compounds cater to automotive for interior solutions, compounding etc.

[Learn More][20]

[][21]

#### [Evonik][22]

One of the leading & largest companies in the world manufacturing the most specialised fumed and
precipitated silica for different applications such as antifoams, coatings etc.
[Learn More][23]
[][24]

#### [3M][25]

3M is the leading company in the world for speciality textile coatings representing ‘PM (PROTECTIVE
MATERIAL) SERIES’, a fluoro-chemical free chemistry.

[Learn More][26]

[][27]

#### [Clariant][28]

As a global provider of solutions for the textile industry, Clariant offers historical expertise to
improve the quality of fibres and garments.

[Learn More][29]

[][30]

#### [Azelis][31]

A leading chemical distribution company representing key brands of detergent & textile
intermediates.

[Learn More][32]

## Client Testimonials

“My association with K. K. Chemicals goes back more than 17 years. K. K. Chempro and K. K. Chemicals
are very trustworthy, technically qualified company.

Nitin Sethi, the director, is well-versed and has huge infield experience in many silicone products.
The staff is very courteous and helpful in a best possible way.

They have helped us many times with the perfectly right information. My best wishes and full thumbs
up to them.”

 

### Mr. Haresh Sharma, GM – Technical, *Ajit Industries*

### Mr. Paresh Kothari, Director, *Spot On Coatings*, Surat

# Lehmann&Voss&Co.
# Ihr Experte in der Welt der chemischen, mineralischen und Kunststoff-Spezialitäten.

Lehmann&Voss&Co. ist ein Unternehmen der Chemie und vermarktet seit mehr als 125 Jahren chemische,
mineralische und Kunststoff-Spezialitäten an industrielle Abnehmer. 1894 als Handelshaus in Hamburg
gegründet, hat sich unser Unternehmen zu einer leistungsstarken, anwendungstechnisch orientierten
Vertriebsorganisation entwickelt - mit langjährigen Verbindungen zu überwiegend ausländischen
Lieferanten und mit eigenen Produktionsstätten.

# Lehmann&Voss&Co.
# Ihr Experte in der Welt der chemischen, mineralischen und Kunststoff-Spezialitäten.

Lehmann&Voss&Co. ist ein Unternehmen der Chemie und vermarktet seit mehr als 125 Jahren chemische,
mineralische und Kunststoff-Spezialitäten an industrielle Abnehmer. 1894 als Handelshaus in Hamburg
gegründet, hat sich unser Unternehmen zu einer leistungsstarken, anwendungstechnisch orientierten
Vertriebsorganisation entwickelt - mit langjährigen Verbindungen zu überwiegend ausländischen
Lieferanten und mit eigenen Produktionsstätten.

Together Amber Synthetics, Alemark Chemicals and CS&D became Amsyn Incorporated, a uniquely integrated organization adapted to meet the full range of development, commercialization and distribution needs of the chemical industry. The primary corporate mission is to provide prompt and professional response to the needs of customers and suppliers. The fulfillment of this objective has resulted in steady growth each year in all operational areas.

### From antioxidants to ozone-protective waxes – everything from a single source

Anti-aging agents are a key component for the performance and service life of modern elastomer
materials. In use, elastomers are constantly exposed to stresses caused by oxygen, heat, ozone, UV
radiation, and mechanical stress. Without proper stabilization, these factors lead to embrittlement,
cracking, loss of mechanical properties, or visual changes. Nordmann’s portfolio of anti-aging
agents is designed to specifically address these aging mechanisms and reliably protect materials
throughout their entire service life—whether they are dynamically highly stressed black compounds or
color-stable, light-colored applications.

# Leading International Chemical Suppliers

Norkem is a leading international chemical supplier and distributor and our Head Office is based in
Knutsford, Cheshire in the UK.  We source and stock the highest quality speciality and industrial
chemicals with offices in many parts of the world and are active across six continents.  We obtain
and supply chemicals for a broad spectrum of uses; including the agrochemical, animal feed, food and
drink, industrial, and pharmaceutical industries.  We also produce a range of suspensions and stains
which are primarily used in the brick and building industries.  Our products can be supplied in
various types and sizes of packaging, including bulk deliveries. Due to our global reach as a
chemical distributor, we are effectively able to minimise both the lead and delivery times to
expedite supply to our customers.

At Norkem, we pride ourselves upon our excellent industry knowledge, our highly experienced and
professional sales teams fully understand the products and markets in which we work.  This expertise
means that we are perfectly placed to assist with your enquiries and requirements.

We have excellent long-standing relationships with fully-accredited suppliers and you can depend on
us to reliably source the chemicals that you need at a competitive price.  For further security, we
keep a very close eye on the chemical supply pipelines and have contingency plans in place to ensure
the continuity of supply in our endeavour not to let our customers down.

As a chemical supplier, Norkem is firmly committed to meeting the highest environmental and health
and safety standards. We are also thoroughly dedicated to working towards a more sustainable future
for the chemical distribution industry.

If you would like any further information or assistance, please do not hesitate to contact us. You
will find our full contact details available here on our website and a member of staff from one of
our sales teams will be only too pleased to help you. [Contact us now.][59]

_crawl.about: BUILDING BRIDGES IN A COMPLEX WORLD Novasol Chemicals is an independent, 100% privately owned, Chemical Distribution company, established in Belgium in 1997. Novasol Chemicals provides tailor-made solutions and multiple packaging capabilities for a broad portfolio of Commodities and Specialty chemicals. We serve a wide range of customers active in areas of Resins & Coatings, Construction, Pharmaceuticals, Agrochemicals, Petrochemicals and Gas, Industrial Applications, Water Treatment and Home Care & Personal Care. A high level of quality and safety is ensured across all our services such as wholesaling, warehousing, filling & repacking, distribution and on-time delivery. The NC Group, headquartered in Brussels, is active in Asia, Europe and North America with local teams located in more than 25 countries. Ranked in the ICIS TOP 100 of chemical Distributors, ISO 9001 certified and compliant with REACH and GHS-CLP regulations. OUR PRODUCT PORTFOLIO o RESINS & COATINGS: Specialty Methacrylate, Commodity Methacrylate, Specialty Acrylate monomers, Commodity Acrylate, Hydroxy monomers, Crosslinking agents, Carbonates, Solids, solvents, Additives. o CONSTRUCTION: Antifoams, Additives, Lubricants o INDUSTRIAL APPLICATIONS: Water, Oil & Gas treatment, Denaturants, Pure Solvents, Crosslinking additives, Additives. o PHARMA, AGRO: Reaction & extraction solvents, reagents & building blocks, o PERSONAL CARE: Flavors & Fragrances: Emulsifiers, Emollients, Active ingredients, extracts, botanicals, commodity, surfactants, Thickeners, Hair care, Sun care, cosmetics. THE 4 I's PRINCIPLES: INTEGRITY - INTIMACY - INTELLIGENCE - IMPROVEMENT are the foundation of our company culture and ways of working. The Group has decades of experience across a multitude of industries. We always seek to deliver the
best to our clients. Along with key partners, we continue to strive toward excellence in all five of
our sectors: [consumer goods][23], [chemicals][24], [banking & finance][25], [logistics][26], and
[agriculture][27].

# Obegi Consumer Products Holding

Supplying customers with premium consumer goods, Obegi Consumer Products Holding [(OCPH)][29] has
developed a diverse portfolio through its distribution, sales, and logistics services. We distribute
household goods and consumables while also providing brand support services. Through partnerships
and joint ventures, [OCPH][30] has successfully linked its offices across the Levant and Morocco
with brands around the world.

[Learn more][31]
[Consumer Goods girl in front of refrigerator]

# **Obegi Chemicals**

Established in 1905, Obegi Chemicals laid the foundation for what would later become Obegi Group.
Over a century of experience has allowed us to become one of the market leaders in manufacturing,
terminaling, and trading of chemicals in the EMEA region.

[Learn more][32]
[chemicals industry]

# **BEMO Europe**

Launched in 1984 inLuxembourg, BEMO Europe has a Luxembourg banking license and is regulated by the
CSSF. BEMO Europe has since solidified its position as a reference in private banking and wealth
management. Specialized in standard banking services, wealth engineering, real estate financing, and
concierge services, BEMO Europe offers customized financial solutions according to each client’s
needs.

[Learn more][33]
[bank bemo industry]

# Logistica

Logistica has been operational since 1959 and was initially geared towards Obegi Consumer Group’s
internal supply chain. With our unmatched standards of professionalism, efficacy, and service
excellence in brokerage, distribution, warehousing, and co-packing, we have drawn external clients
like McDonald’s to seek our assistance and expertise on the logistical end.

[Learn more][34]
[logistics industry]

# Unifert

Since our involvement in the agricultural sector in 1968, our mission is to provide comprehensive
solutions to the agricultural industry.
Half a century after its inception, Unifert, a Luxembourg-based company, remains a leading player in
the international trade of fertilizers, and other services catered towards the agricultural sector -
especially in Europe and the MENA region. We aim to maintain that position by consistently
delivering on our initial promise to formulate and create innovative solutions within our field.

[Learn more][35]

our sectors: [consumer goods][23], [chemicals][24], [banking & finance][25], [logistics][26], and

# Obegi Consumer Products Holding

Supplying customers with premium consumer goods, Obegi Consumer Products Holding [(OCPH)][29] has
developed a diverse portfolio through its distribution, sales, and logistics services. We distribute
household goods and consumables while also providing brand support services. Through partnerships
and joint ventures, [OCPH][30] has successfully linked its offices across the Levant and Morocco
with brands around the world.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Established in 1905, Obegi Chemicals Group is a leading chemical distributor across the Middle East and Africa. Obegi Chemicals prides itself on its heritage, long-acquired skills and well-established relationships in a diverse and adverse environment. We represent major international suppliers and provide a diverse array of products and services to various sectors such as coatings, construction, polyurethane, personal & home care, pharmaceuticals, human & animal nutrition and oil & gas through our 3 business divisions: Fine Chemicals, Performance Chemicals and Infrastructure solutions. Obegi Chemicals continued to reach new destinations. In 2010, our partnership with the Fahmy family continued with the launching of Alexandria Chemicals Terminal-ALXCT. This enterprise served as the first bulk terminal for chemicals on the Mediterranean coast of Egypt and the logistics base for manufacturing and distribution activities in the MENA region. Moreover, the establishment of ALXCT paved the way in 2017 for the founding of OCIP, a major investment in manufacturing that is also based in Egypt. This strategic move took Obegi Chemicals to the next level.

Producing a range of natural mineral products from calcium carbonate, dolomite, and perlite, the Omya Group has 160 plants across the world. With three technical centers, in Switzerland, the US, and Singapore, as well as a network of local laboratories providing innovation, R&D and technical resource, the Omya Group delivers value by providing solutions tailored to the needs of our customers and business partners. Founded in Switzerland in 1884 and privately owned, the Group employs 9,000 people in 50 countries.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Established in 1925, today Palmer Holland is a North American specialty chemical and fine ingredient distributor of raw materials headquartered in Cleveland, Ohio with 60+ account managers stationed throughout the United States and Canada. _crawl.linkedin_about: Protea Chemicals Omnia's Chemical division, operating under the Protea Chemicals brand, is a longstanding and well- respected distributor of speciality, functional and effect chemicals and polymers in much of sub-Saharan Africa. Focused on providing customers with value-added chemical products and services, Protea Chemicals strives to be 'more than just a chemical supplier'​. Protea Chemicals competes in almost every sector of the chemical distribution market, including personal care and cosmetics, food and beverages, water treatment, engineering, paints and inks, textiles, plastics, rubber, chemical manufacturing and formulation, petroleum and lubrication, packaging and paper, pharmaceuticals and healthcare and animal feeds. The company operates from 21 sites located in all major industrial centres throughout Southern Africa, from Nairobi to Cape Town. Omnia Group Omnia has been in business for over 60 years and is listed in the Chemicals sector of the Johannesburg Securities Exchange, with a market capitalisation of approximately R 14.3 billion. Omnia is a diversified provider of specialised chemical products and services used in the mining, agricultural and chemical sectors. The Group differentiates itself from commodity chemical providers by adding value at every stage of the supply and service chain through technological innovation and by deploying our intellectual capital. We make our business model sustainable by targeted backward integration through installing technologically-advanced plants to manufacture core materials such as nitric acid and explosives emulsions. Annual Revenue is around R16 billion and the company has operations in 25 Countries and 4000 employees. The group comprises Omnia Fertilizer, Protea Chemicals, Protea Mining Chemicals and BME.

## 80 años a tu servicio

Desde su fundación en 1944, en Quimidroga llevamos 80 años esforzándonos para dar respuesta a las
necesidades de proveedores y clientes. La confianza, la transparencia y el trato familiar, han sido
nuestras herramientas para crecer y construir una compañía que, más allá de distribuir productos
químicos, se dedica a aportar soluciones.

Ahora, ponemos a tu disposición la experiencia acumulada durante todos estos años para ayudarte en
todo aquello que puedas necesitar.

[Conócenos][106]

## Sostenibilidad: la base de nuestra filosofía de negocio

Nuestro compromiso es compartir nuestros conocimientos y recursos a través de la distribución y a la
vez crear y ayudar a crear soluciones sostenibles, cubriendo en la medida de lo posible todos los
puntos del ciclo de vida de un producto, intentando siempre minimizar el impacto medioambiental
generado por nuestra actividad.

El compromiso de Quimidroga con la sostenibilidad va más allá de sus operaciones comerciales y
alcanza a sus comunidades, clientes y representadas.

La simplicidad alcanza otro nivel con [plinko ball][107], un juego donde cada rebote despierta
nuevas sensaciones y mantiene viva la intriga.

[Nuestra estrategia de Sostenibilidad][108]

_crawl.linkedin_about: Quimidroga S.A. is a company founded in 1944 in Barcelona dedicated to the marketing and distribution of chemical products, whose mission is to contribute to the development of a more sustainable chemical industry. Headquartered in Barcelona and present throughout the Mediterranean Arc, Quimidroga works every day to become the benchmark distributor in Southern Europe. Quimidroga seeks to be a reference through its way of understanding and developing its activity: constant work, a close relationship with suppliers and clients based on trust and transparency, and a deep knowledge of our activity, which allows us to position ourselves as a company specialised in each of the industrial sectors in which we are present. The sustained practice of these principles by a team of more than 500 people has made us the undisputed leader in our sector for the Iberian Peninsula and one of the top 10 European distributors. In 2022 Quimidroga registered a turnover of €1 248 million. Not only does Quimidroga market a wide range of chemical products ranging from basic industrial products or commodities to the most sophisticated specialties, but it is also integrated into the supply chain of clients and suppliers, carrying out all kinds of operations, thanks to its extensive distribution network which has one of the most modern and best equipped Logistics Complexes in Europe. It is also involved in the development of new solutions from its R&D&I laboratories.

our customers, offering global reach with local insights. In a challenging marketplace, REDA
Chemicals stands as your partner in advancing industrial capabilities efficiently and effectively.

insulation materials, consist of the materials we provide.

Ravago provides a superior distribution, resale, compounding and recycling service for plastic and
elastomeric raw materials serving sophisticated functions that improve the sustainable quality of
our life.

# World Class Chemical Solutions

## Welcome to Solventis

Solventis is a major chemical solvent supplier and one of the largest producers of coolants,
antifreeze, brake fluids and aircraft de-icing fluids in Europe. From our state-of-the-art,

## The perfect partner for production, transportation and storage of chemicals, solvents and

**SOLVOCHEM**, suppliers of chemicals, solvents and plastics worldwide is a rapidly expanding
international group of distribution and trading companies, which has grown significantly since its
beginning in the Middle East. Today the group consists of several affiliated companies based in
various European, Middle Eastern and African countries.

particularly successful in the sale and distribution of various raw materials to a large number of
industries in the Mediterranean area, the Middle East and Africa. Local demands have also lead to
the opening of Chemical Industrial Factories.

## Einkauf

Wenn es auf Ihrer Liste steht,
können wir es beschaffen


Auch beim Einkauf zahlt sich die große Erfahrung und weltweite Präsenz von TER Chemicals für Sie
aus: Schnelle Warenverfügbarkeit durch Lagerhaltung eines breiten Portfolios und konstante
marktgerechte Preise sind bei uns selbstverständlich. Im Sinne der Planungs- und Produktsicherheit
veröffentlichen wir Rohstoff-Preisprognosen (für Importe) und geben Spezifikationsgarantien. Für
unsere Key Account beschaffen wir auch gern ganze Jahreskontingente. Die Zahlungsziele für unsere
Kunden gestalten wir dabei individuell nach Kontext. Zudem sichern wir Transaktionen ggf. mit
Mitteln der Währungssicherung sowie mit Kreditversicherungen (Euler Hermes) ab. Nicht zuletzt diese
Sorgfalt sowie ein strenges Qualitätsmanagement, zu dem auch wiederkehrende Lieferantenaudits (für
Importe) gehören, haben uns zu einem weltweit renommierten Importeur gemacht.

## Vertrieb

Ihr direkter Weg
zum Kunden

Als Kenner des Marktes der Rohstoffe, Spezialchemikalien und deren Formulierungen können wir Sie mit
unserem Know-how auch bei Produkteinführungen und Marktausweitungen beraten und unterstützen. Dazu
gehören Wettbewerbsbeobachtungen, Marktreporte und Marktpotenzialbewertungen ebenso wie effektives
Online-Marketing (www.lanuco.de) oder Präsenz auf Messen. Dank unserer hohen Marktdurchdringung
haben wir dabei in Europa einen besonders guten Kundenzugang. Für unsere Serviceleistungen im
Vertrieb beschäftigen wir ein spezialisiertes Team – bestehend aus Key Supplier Management, Product
Management und Account Management –  das sich durch fundierte Fachkenntnisse und exzellente
Kommunikationsfähigkeiten auszeichnet.

## Logistik

DAS GANZE PAKET –
EFFIZIENZ, TERMINTREUE, UMFASSENDER SERVICE

Logistik ist ein ganz wesentlicher Bestandteil unseres Leistungsspektrums. Über unsere dezentralen
Lagerhäuser bieten wir unseren Kunden termingerechte bzw. just-in-time Belieferung selbst bei
komplizierten Anforderungen. Dabei sind auch direkte Streckenlieferungen vom Hersteller zu unserem
Kunden möglich ­– weltweit. Doch unser Service beginnt schon früher. So gehören das Umfüllen auf
Kleingebinde (z.T. GMP-konform), das Umverpacken (ggf. mit kundenindividuelle Etiketten), die
Produktveredelung (Zerkleinern, Mischen, Vermahlen, Verflockung), die Konfektionierung gemischter
Paletten, sowie die optimierte Feindistribution von Kleinmengen ebenso zu unseren Leistungen. Unser
hohes Serviceniveau wird garantiert durch speziell ausgebildete Logistikfachleute und eine strenge
Qualitätssicherung. Seit 2011 sind wir AEO-zertifiziert. Mit der LZ Logistik GmbH verfügt unsere
Unternehmensgruppe seit 2014 zudem über ein eigenes Logistikunternehmen, das sich insbesondere um
die Abwicklung des Lagergeschäftes an unserem Firmensitz und Hafenstandort Hamburg kümmert.

With resources around the world, Tilley is one of the largest and most well-diversified distributors of ingredients, flavor and fragrance, specialty chemicals and lubricants. When you work with Tilley, you have access to in-house engineering and technical expertise, state-of-the-art logistics and supply chain support, and an expansive product catalog matched by few in the distribution industry. At Tilley, we work to fill supply chain gaps with turnkey solutions to alleviate stress surrounding logistics, purchasing and operations. Whether you are searching for ingredients, lubricants, blending and packaging services, or custom formulation, Tilley is ready to build your solution.

** WELCOME **

## Our purpose is to sustainably and efficiently connect the world with essential goods.

We add value to our suppliers and customers through providing superior logistics, risk management,
financing, and market intelligence services. We originate and market products globally, meeting
specific location, quality, timing and volume requirements. We also provide a versatile range of
price risk management and contracting alternatives to our clients. Every day, we strive to enhance
international commerce through the physical movement and marketing of industrial chemicals, fuels,
plastic intermediates, and fertilizers. We are committed to providing our clients and suppliers with
streamlined services, so they can focus on their core business. With our worldwide team of
professionals, we have grown from a business that began with distribution of caustic soda, to a
globally recognized company, trading hundreds of products.

Company Overview
[Company Overview]

#### LOGISTICS

Logistics management is a key activity and core competence in our business. Our expertise covers
multiple modes of transport, including railcars, barges, and both dry bulk and liquids vessels. We
recently created Lighthouse, a freight brokerage joint venture, continuing to strengthen our
capabilities in this critical area.

#### MARKET INTELLIGENCE

Our extended coverage around the world, with presence across numerous markets provides us with
unique insights and allows us to spot valuable opportunities. We carefully cultivate relationships
with market participants, including via sponsorship and participation of several industry
conferences.

#### RISK MANAGEMENT

We manage various risks in our operations, including price risk, credit, liquidity and operational
risks. The goal of our process is to minimize costs for our suppliers and customers, while reducing
uncertainty inherent in the commodity trade flows we handle.

#### Financing

Inherent to our business we provide various forms of financing to our customers and suppliers.  We
participate in prepayment arrangements, secured financing structures, and provide open account
terms.

## Social And Corporate Responsibility

### Tricon Cares

We run our business with the clear goal of ensuring complete customer and supplier satisfaction by
addressing the needs of the physical commodity industry and adding material value to the overall
supply chain. However, we are also keenly aware that corporate responsibility is key to managing
risks and maximizing on the opportunities available to all of us in a changing world.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Tricon Energy is an industry leader in the global trade and distribution market. Founded in 1996, Tricon has grown into one of the largest privately held companies in Houston, Texas, with annual revenues of several billion dollars. We employ talent in nearly forty countries and conduct business in over one hundred. We add value to our suppliers and customers by providing superior logistics, risk management, financing, and market intelligence services. We originate and market products globally, meeting specific location, quality, timing and volume requirements. We also provide a versatile range of price risk management and contracting alternatives to our clients. Each day, we strive to enhance international commerce through the physical movement and marketing of industrial chemicals, dry bulk, fuels, plastic intermediates, and fertilizers. We are committed to providing our clients and suppliers with streamlined services so they can focus on their core business. With our worldwide team of professionals, we have grown from a business that began with distribution of caustic soda, to a globally recognized company trading and distributing hundreds of products.

We focus on building our partners’ success by investing in long term relationships with them. We
make serving our partners not just our job but our passion. Our teams combine commercial savviness
and technical expertise, allowing us to deliver added-value for both our suppliers and customers.

just-in-time service you merit. Using our experience in the safe handling of raw materials,
additives and ingredients we make sure that our products arrive safely and on time at our customers.
Combined with an efficient logistic system to source from Europe, Asia and other countries we are
able to offer you a comprehensive product portfolio locally with an excellent service.

toward quality is comprehensive and systematic which enables continuous quality improvement.

## Why Vidara?

We focus on building our partners’ success by investing in long term relationships with them. We
make serving our partners not just our job but our passion. Our teams combine commercial savviness
and technical expertise, allowing us to deliver added-value for both our suppliers and customers.

[
Our Technical Expertise
][24]

With our warehouses strategically spread over the region we are able to provide you with the
just-in-time service you merit. Using our experience in the safe handling of raw materials,
additives and ingredients we make sure that our products arrive safely and on time at our customers.
Combined with an efficient logistic system to source from Europe, Asia and other countries we are
able to offer you a comprehensive product portfolio locally with an excellent service.

[
Our Supply Chain Solutions
][25]

At Vidara, quality has a high priority which is well embedded in our company culture. Our approach
toward quality is comprehensive and systematic which enables continuous quality improvement.

_crawl.linkedin_about: KRAHN Chemie GmbH is a chemical distribution company with a history spanning over 100 years. Its core competences are sales, marketing and distribution of specialty chemicals and heat transfer fluids. KRAHN offers its more than 5,000 customers an extensive and high-quality product range, technical services as well as in-house laboratory support, and works closely together with international chemical manufacturers. They benefit from its target-oriented product marketing — utilizing deep knowledge of local markets. KRAHN supplies products to the following processing industries: coatings, construction, adhesives and sealants, plastics, rubber, fuels and lubricants, industrial cleaning and home care, personal care, chemical intermediates as well as all industrial sectors in which heating and cooling circuits are used. The headquarter is located in Hamburg, Germany. It has subsidiaries and local sales teams in the Benelux, France, Italy, Poland, Greece, Sweden, United Kingdom, Spain, Austria, Romania, the Czech Republic and Hungary. The company group is part of the family-owned and globally active Otto Krahn Group.

_crawl.linkedin_about: Petrochem Middle East (PME) has grown to become one of the largest independent chemical distributors in the Middle East, with ISO 9001, ISO 140001 and OHSAS 18001 certifications. Started in 1995 in the Jebel Ali Free Zone, the company has fast transformed the petrochemical business in the region with its wide range of products and unique service proposition. With operations staff adhering to stringent health and safety regulations to ensure the safety of our staff and enabling our customers to receive the best service possible. We have offices and distribution facilities in the UAE (Dubai and Jebel Ali), India, China, Singapore, Turkey and Egypt together with associate offices in London and Antwerp. A dedicated and ultra-modern fleet of road tankers and large trailer trucks, as well as an in-house logistics and operations department that ensure quick and on time deliveries. PME offers chemical solutions for many industries including the paint and coating industry; oil and gas plus feed stock manufacturers. Our clients include some of the world’s most renowned companies. Our Chemical Storing Terminal is a state of the art facility in Dubai’s Jebel Ali Free Zone, which handles more than 250 variants of chemicals. Established in 1999, the existing facility includes 3 dedicated Jetty pipe lines, 23 bulk storage tanks for import and storage of products in bulk with total storage capacity to 25650m3, drumming facility, tanker/ISO tanks loading gantry with top loading arms, 5 Canopies for storage of NFPA class 1 B & C chemicals with approx. 35,000 drums storage capacity, a state of the art firefighting system covering all areas with foam and sprinkler and all other associated infrastructural facilities. The terminal exports more than 1,000,000 metric tons of products to all the corners of the world.
